title: Imported work orders still have no sales representative
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use an imported work order at the test location (one brought in from the previous system).
  • Have a screenshot of this imported work order's card taken before the release was installed, so you can compare.
  • With the release installed, open the work order in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is no Sales Representative field.
  • There is no + button.
  • The imported work order looks the same as in the screenshot taken before the release.
